import subprocess
import sys
import os
import json
import tempfile
from unittest.mock import patch


class TestПроверкаЛицензий(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.script = os.path.abspath("проверка_лицензий.py")

        result = subprocess.run(

            f.write("C;MIT\n")
            f.write("D;BSD-3-Clause\n")
            f.write("E;MIT\n")

            with patch.object(sys, "argv", ["проверка_лицензий.py", f.name]):
                result = self._run([])
        os.unlink(f.name)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertIn("Итого: допустимо — 5, требует проверки — 0", result.stdout)

            f.write("B;Apache-2.0\n")
            f.write("C;MIT\n")
            f.write("D;BSD-3-Clause\n")

        data = json.loads(lines[0])

    def test_empty_input(self):
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w+", newline="", encoding="utf-8", delete=False) as f:
            f.write("компонент;лицензия\n")
            f.flush()
            with patch.object(sys, "argv", ["проверка_лицензий.py", f.name]):
                result = self._run([])
        os.unlink(f.name)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertIn("Итого: допустимо — 0, требует проверки — 0", result.stdout)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import json
import tempfile
from unittest.mock import patch


class TestПроверкаЛицензий(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.script = os.path.abspath("проверка_лицензий.py")

    def _run(self, args, stdin_data=None):
        cmd = [sys.executable, self.script] + args
        result = subprocess.run(
            cmd,
            input=stdin_data,
            text=True,
            capture_output=True,
        )
        return result

    def test_stdout_summary(self):
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w+", newline="", encoding="utf-8", delete=False) as f:
            f.write("компонент;лицензия\n")
            f.write("A;MIT\n")
            f.write("B;Apache-2.0\n")
            f.write("C;MIT\n")
            f.write("D;BSD-3-Clause\n")
            f.write("E;MIT\n")
            f.flush()
            with patch.object(sys, "argv", ["проверка_лицензий.py", f.name]):
                result = self._run([])
        os.unlink(f.name)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertIn("Итого: допустимо — 5, требует проверки — 0", result.stdout)

    def test_json_output(self):
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w+", newline="", encoding="utf-8", delete=False) as f:
            f.write("компонент;лицензия\n")
            f.write("A;MIT\n")
            f.write("B;Apache-2.0\n")
            f.write("C;MIT\n")
            f.write("D;BSD-3-Clause\n")
            f.write("E;MIT\n")

            with patch.object(sys, "argv", ["проверка_лицензий.py", "--json", f.name]):
                result = self._run([])
        os.unlink(f.name)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        lines = [ln for ln in result.stdout.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
        self.assertEqual(len(lines), 1)
        data = json.loads(lines[0])
        self.assertEqual(data, {"допустимо": 5, "требует_проверки": 0})

    def test_empty_input(self):
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w+", newline="", encoding="utf-8", delete=False) as f:
            f.write("компонент;лицензия\n")
            f.flush()
            with patch.object(sys, "argv", ["проверка_лицензий.py", f.name]):
                result = self._run([])
        os.unlink(f.name)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertIn("Итого: допустимо — 0, требует проверки — 0", result.stdout)
